intro.lede: I’m Shengbo. I build software and study how it can help us understand the world—and do a little more for it. Eight projects are waiting as eight small islands. Scroll, and the boat will take you to each.
intro.aside: Every island was modelled and lit by hand for this site. The boat is the trimaran from one of the projects.
intro.bridge: Casting off. First heading: 2024, and a biology team that needed its science explained.

chart.heading:
Eight islands,
one habit.
chart.lede: Seen from above, the route is one idea repeated: build the thing, then check whether it does what you say it does. Choose any island to go back, or read the projects as a list.
